Rule text: for a lot whose Chapter 900 exception is not authored, the route is undecided, not refused. The words "or a lot gate applies" in the not_permitted clause above mean a decided refusal; an unauthored exception is the gate of M-231 (Spec 134 section 5), which takes no winner on any target and writes not_evaluated:exception_not_authored on the lot. By R3-01 (M-385, undecided never means zero) the route for such a lot carries not_evaluated:exception_not_authored and is never not_permitted. Every other statement of this row is unchanged.
